questions.q: Which hook is used to manage local state in a function component?
questions.explanation: useState() returns the current state value and a setter that triggers a re-render.

questions.q: Why should each item in a rendered list have a stable key prop?
options: It sets the CSS class for the item
It helps React identify which items changed
It fetches data for the item
questions.explanation: Keys let React match list items between renders and update only what changed.

questions.q: Which hook is designed for running side effects after render?
questions.explanation: useEffect() runs after render and is the standard place for side effects.

questions.q: How should you update state when the next value depends on the previous value?
questions.explanation: The functional updater receives the latest state, avoiding stale closure values.
